llm.title: AI Assistant
llm.lead: Enhance card help, rules Q&A, coach tips, battle reports, search, and more. Your key stays in this browser and is sent only to the API base URL you enter.
llm.warning: Most providers block browser CORS. Use an endpoint that allows browser calls (or your own proxy). Never paste a key you cannot rotate.
llm.cacheHint: Stable answers (card text, rules, archetypes, etc.) are cached on this device with no expiry. Changing model or API base uses a separate cache.
llm.chatLead: Ask free-form Magic questions about what you are looking at on this page. Conversation resets when you reopen or change pages.
llm.chatEmpty: Ask about this set, these cards, Challenge rules, or any Magic topic.
llm.needKey: Set an API key via the footer AI Assistant link to enable this.
llm.nlGalleryPlaceholder: e.g. green fight creatures under 3 mana…

challenge.setupLead: Play a Constructed deck (lands and mana) against the self-running Challenge Deck.
challenge.engineHonesty: Challenge-faithful engine with a limited stack on challenge reveals (pass / Wanderer counter / Fog). First/double strike use combat damage steps; trample can spill excess. Not a full Arena / Comprehensive Rules simulator.
challenge.hordeDelay: Your turns before the Horde acts
challenge.noteConstructed: Choose one Constructed list for all three challenges: play lands, pay mana, cast from hand.
challenge.noteCombat: Select attackers, assign targets (or mill the Horde), then end your turn to let the challenge act.
challenge.noteMana: One land drop per turn; untapped lands and mana creatures auto-pay costs.
challenge.noteOfficial: Challenge-side rules follow official Challenge Decks; the player half implements only what this list needs (not full CR).
challenge.noteHeroes: Optional Hero's Path heroes (up to 2 vs Hydra, 3 vs Horde/God) start on your side.
challenge.pickHeroesHint: Pick up to {{max}} different heroes. You don't need any to play.
challenge.heroOffQuestHint: This hero’s Path quest is for a different Challenge Deck (still usable).
challenge.pickDeckHint: Pick any 60-card Constructed list (shared across all three challenges). Use “View decklist” to preview cards and mana curve.
challenge.rotateLandscape: Rotate your device to landscape to continue
challenge.simplifiedCardHint: This card's printed text is approximated in Challenge.
challenge.attackerHint: Tap a creature to declare an attacker, then click a target on the challenge side.
challenge.assignHint: Click a Head / Reveler / Xenagos to assign your selected attackers.
challenge.hordeAttackHint: Damage to the Horde mills cards from its library.
challenge.blockHint: Click your creatures to cycle blockers onto attackers, then resolve.

tip.resolveCombat: Press Resolve combat to deal damage.
tip.endTurn: Press End turn to pass to the challenge.
tip.targetDamage: Click a target (creature, Head, Horde library, …) for damage.
tip.targetPump: Click one of your creatures to pump.
tip.targetFangs: Click one of your creatures for +1/+1 and lifelink.
tip.targetDestroy: Click an enemy creature to destroy.
tip.fightTheirs: Click an enemy creature to finish the fight.
tip.won: Victory! Play again for another run.
tip.lost: Defeat. Play again to try a different approach.

procedure.stepHydra1: Your turn: cast spells, then attack Heads.
procedure.stepHydra2: Hydra turn: reveal/cast, then Heads deal breath damage.
procedure.stepHydra3: Resolve elite end-step triggers after breath.
procedure.stepHydra4: Win when no Heads remain at end of turn.
procedure.stepHorde1: Take your delayed turns, then the Horde wakes.
procedure.stepHorde3: Assign blockers; unblocked mill your life via combat.
procedure.stepHorde4: Win when Horde library and creatures are gone.
procedure.stepGod1: Xenagos and revelers start on the battlefield.
procedure.stepGod2: God turn: cast top cards, then revelers may attack.
procedure.stepGod3: Xenagos can’t leave while a reveler remains.
procedure.stepGod4: Win by defeating Xenagos with no revelers left.

printAssistant.title: Print assistant
printAssistant.lead: Default: precise 63×88 mm with 1 mm bleed for trimming. Pick paper, adjust quantities, then export.
printAssistant.advancedLead: Precise 63×88 mm cut size. Change only if you need to.
printAssistant.listDirty: Paper, settings, or list changed — reload preview to update.
printAssistant.printTip: Print at Actual size / 100%. Do not use Fit to page — that shrinks cards.
printAssistant.exportReadyLead: Choose how to print or save the file.
printAssistant.exportMobilePrintWarn: Direct web printing on phones can scale incorrectly. Prefer Save, then print from a PDF app.
printAssistant.exportPrintFailed: Could not open the print dialog. Use Save, then print the PDF file.
printAssistant.allFailed: Could not load any card images.

cardEditor.title: Editor
cardEditor.lead: Compose a Magic-style card face from art, text, and frame colors. Export PNG for proxies, JSON for Challenge decks, or send faces to the print assistant.
cardEditor.disclaimer: Fan proxy / custom card tool. Not affiliated with Wizards of the Coast. Frames are geometric approximations for personal use.
cardEditor.statusExportedConstructed: Constructed JSON downloaded. Place the PNG at {{path}} when wiring into a player deck.
cardEditor.deckExportHint: Export Constructed JSON, download PNG, then place the image under public/assets/cards/player/ and merge the JSON into a player deck file.
